# Hugh Lane Gallery at Dublin Gallery Weekend 2026

![](https://hughlane.ie/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/AM_photo-smaller.jpg)

![](https://hughlane.ie/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/AM_photo-smaller.jpg)

Hugh Lane Gallery is proud to be part of Dublin Gallery Weekend 2026.

As part of the weekend, we are delighted to present **Undercurrents: Alice Maher at Venice**, an illustrated talk with one of Ireland’s leading artists.

Alice Maher will discuss the works, both individual and collaborative, she is showing this year at La Biennale di Venezia as part of *In Minor Keys*. A rare opportunity to hear an artist speak first hand about taking part in one of the world’s most important contemporary art exhibitions.

The talk is part of Hugh Lane Gallery’s offsite programme and takes place at Poetry Ireland, our neighbours on Parnell Square while our gallery is closed for refurbishment and to facilitate the

**Saturday 7 November, 12.30pm to 1.30pm**  
Poetry Ireland, 11 Parnell Square East, Dublin 1, D01 ND60

This event is now fully booked however, there’s plenty more to see over the four days.  
Explore the full Dublin Gallery Weekend programme and [plan your weekend here](https://www.dublingalleryweekend.ie.).

The 61st International Art Exhibition of [La Biennale di Venezia](https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=%2Fm%2F01r_f0&q=La+Biennale+di+Venezia), ‘In Minor Keys’ was curated by the late Koyo Kouoh and runs until 22nd November 2026.
